tool: Chromium (Playwright 1.62, headless) + own PNG/step analysis; polygon background paused for the numeric runs, MOVING for the screenshot pairs

root_cause.mechanism: feDisplacementMap reads an undefined (transparent black, R=G=0 => -16px shift on both axes) map outside the feImage primitive subregion, while at the boundary the map holds R=15/G=128 resp. R=128/G=15 => a 13-16px sampling discontinuity => a 1-px crease at exactly 360px / 120px from the surface origin
root_cause.applies_to: every glass surface wider than 360px or taller than 120px (backdrop carrier: whole surface; layer carrier: only inside the ring-mask band)

fix.change: #lg-lens-map subregion now equals the filter region: x=-6% y=-6% width=112% height=112%
unchanged: filter region x=-6% y=-6% width=112% height=112%
glass alpha rgba(21,27,42,.5), radius 22px, ring mask, layer z-index -1
polygon background, refraction animation, health tint path (fill only)

measurements.method: 1-px luma step at the cut-off coordinate vs the total change over the 29-px window; a crease has step >> total (sharpness = step/total)

after.note: no sustained line at the cut-off

invariants_after.card: background-color rgba(141,74,85,.5) in alert; isolation=isolate; overflow=clip

screenshots.note: each live pair was captured as two frames 900 ms apart with the polygon background animating
